spec_case: issue #726 (a library child never saves a file, even through a rendered params_json)
description: A use: ref: child is always limited, whatever its parent is, and loaded from a real file -- so its own params_json keeps a real, unrendered Mustache tag through compilation (unlike a use: inline child, whose inline text is itself rendered once at the parent's own scope, before the child is ever parsed). That tag only resolves to the JSON object {"save_to": ...} at the child's own dispatch time, from a prior effect's own state, so neither the compiler's literal-params check nor its literal-JSON params_json sniff ever sees save_to at compile time. cof's dispatch-time check still refuses it. electricity-only: electricity has no library (DESIGN.md), so this document's own ref: compiles there as a flat refusal, never reaching the scenario at all; the equivalent dispatch-time check on electricity's own use: inline/limited document path is covered directly by a Rust unit test instead.
